author: Jason Stys
summary: Replay paired reviewed cases against current broker policy and separate unsafe allowance, benign availability, completion and oracle coverage.
rationale: Avoids conflating unavailable or unreviewed model behavior with a successful safety result.
limitations: Evaluation replays authored/imported snapshots; it does not run an inference provider or real downstream tool actions.
Model labels are supplied assertions rather than authenticated model identities; there is no aggregate model ranking.
Accepted-text semantics can remain ungraded, and a finite reviewed corpus does not prove universal model security.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
